name: Explore CEOS-ARD Products
description: Broad discovery across CEOS-ARD assessed optical, thermal and radar products.
notes: This profile is deliberately inclusive. Unreported optional metadata is flagged for a manual task check.
assumptions: CEOS-ARD assessment describes product preparation and documentation, not fitness for a specific application.

name: Map Land and Features
description: Fine-detail mapping with CEOS-ARD assessed land-observation products.
notes: Product family and profile criteria remain editable. Review task-specific geometric accuracy and suitability manually.
assumptions: Fine spatial detail does not establish cadastral, engineering, survey-grade or precision-mapping suitability.

name: Monitor Change Over Time
description: Time-series and change monitoring with CEOS-ARD assessed products.
notes: Nominal revisit does not prove operational latency, cloud-free availability, acquisition priority or delivery frequency.
assumptions: Geometry and long-term co-registration suitability require a manual task check.
